selection.rule: Highest full SDK score on all 77 new-synthetic validation cases x3; frozen before eval.

method: Near-cycle pure scheduler plus per-case online transition prediction; preserves exact public lookahead and capacity enforcement.

prediction_usage.note: Counts candidate protection computations, not unique callbacks or overall hidden-probe accuracy.

scope: Observed development regression; diagnostics kept separate. Hybrid uses online prediction and is not recorded as a pure-only result.
